description: Fire a correctly-signed synthetic webhook event (Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, Slack) at a local handler - develop and test a webhook handler with NO provider account, dashboard, or real event needed. Pass the signing secret and the handler will pass its signature verification. Omit event/target and pass list=true to see available events. Fully local, no credits.

body.description: Override the generated payload with raw JSON

list.description: List available providers and events instead of sending

secret.description: Signing secret - signs the event so the handler's verification passes

name: event_send
title: Send a synthetic signed provider event
